question: Ari has searched their library this turn with [Bog Glider]. During their end step, Nico casts [Mission Briefing]. Can they use it to cast [Archive Trap] from their graveyard for free?
answer_gold: Yes. Mission Briefing allows Nico to cast Archive Trap from their graveyard, without any other restrictions on how it's cast. Nico can choose to pay the alternative cost of {0}.

question: In a game of Two-Headed Giant, Antonio activates the last loyalty ability of [Chandra, Hope's Beacon] with X=1. Could they target both Nico and Noah?
answer_gold: Yes. Each member of a team is a separate player and is targeted independently.

question: Avalyn has no cards in their library and controls a [Keranos, God of Storms]. What happens at the beginning of their draw step?
answer_gold: Avalyn can't draw a card, so no card is revealed and neither trigger triggers. Avalyn loses the game before they would next get priority.

question: Abdullah casts [Telemin Performance] targeting Nico. In response, Nico casts [Veil of Summer]. Abdullah responds with their own Veil of Summer. What happens?
answer_gold:
Abdullah's Veil of Summer resolves first. Then Nico's resolves and draws them a card. Then Telemin Performance tries to resolve and fails, since it has an illegal target.

(Abdullah's Veil of Summer didn't accomplish anything useful.)

question: Athena controls [Teferi, Time Raveler] and Nicholas flashes in [The Wandering Emperor] on Athena's turn. Can Nicholas activate its abilities this turn?
answer_gold: This can't happen as described. Nicholas cannot cast The Wandering Emperor on Athena's turn due to Teferi, Time Raveler's effect.

question: In a Two-Headed Giant game, how much life does each team begin the game with?
Aldo casts [Lumithread Field] for its morph cost. If Nico wants to counter it with [Spell Burst], what is the mana value of the Lumithread Field on the stack?
answer_gold: 0. A morphed spell is a 2/2 creature with no mana cost. Since the spell has no mana cost, its mana value is 0.

question: Alexis would like to choose colorless for [Regicide]. Can they?
answer_gold: No. Colorless is not a color.

question: Alfonso controls [Cyclops of One-Eyed Pass] equipped with [Glaive of the Guildpact] and no Gates. Does it have vigilance and menace?
answer_gold: Yes. The only thing that Gates affect is how much Cyclops of One-Eyed Pass's power is increased.

question: Ainsley casts [Tandem Takedown], granting their two [Devoted Hero] +1/+0. Can each Devoted Hero deal damage to a different one of Nolan's creatures?
answer_gold: No. Tandem Takedown specifies that they each deal damage to another target creature, meaning one single other creature.

question: Aaden has 3 [Witch's Familiar] in their graveyard and casts [Izoni, Thousand-Eyed]. After it enters the battlefield but before its trigger resolves, Nyla activates [Sentinel Totem] to exile all cards from Aaden's graveyard. When Izoni, Thousand-Eyed's ability resolves, how many tokens will be created?
answer_gold: 0. The number of tokens to create is determined when the ability resolves, by which point the graveyard has no creatures in it.

question: Atlas casts [Piracy] and would like to tap all of Nicole's lands but not cast any spells. Can Atlas do this?
answer_gold: Yes. Piracy creates a restriction on what Atlas must spend the mana on, but does not prevent them from not spending the mana.

question: Annie controls [Heliod, Sun-Crowned] and casts [Essence Feed]. Can they choose to put Heliod, Sun-Crowned's +1/+1 counter on one of the tokens created by Essence Feed?
answer_gold: Yes. Annie creates the tokens, then gains life as part of the resolution of Essence Feed. After Essence Feed has resolved, Heliod, Sun-Crowned's trigger will be put on the stack. At that point Annie can choose a token as their target.

question: Aleah casts [Clash of Titans], can Aleah choose Nixon's [Storm Crow] for both targets?
answer_gold: No. The word "another" here retains its normal English meaning, and means that both targets cannot be the same creature.

question: Alejandro controls [Vorinclex, Monstrous Raider] and two [Blight Mamba]s. If Alejandro deals combat damage with both Blight Mambas, how many poison counters will Nico get?
answer_gold: Two damage will be dealt to Nico and they will get four poison counters. ([702.164c], [702.90b])

question: Andre casts [Abrupt Decay] targeting Nico's 5/5 Horse creature token, then responds by targeting it with [Arcane Denial]. What happens?
answer_gold: Arcane Denial resolves but can't counter Abrupt Decay. During Nico's upkeep, Andre draws one to three cards, based on their choice.

question: Arabella controls [Yixlid Jailer] and casts [Ever After] targeting [Dearly Departed] and [Fugitive Wizard]. Will Fugitive Wizard enter with a +1/+1 counter?
answer_gold: No. Dearly Departed has no abilities while in the graveyard.

question: Nicholas controls [Solitary Confinement]. Addilyn attacks with [Ranger of Eos] and casts [Skullcrack] targeting themselves. Does Nicholas lose life?
answer_gold: Yes. Skullcrack says that damage can't be prevented, so Solitary Confinement doesn't prevent it.

question: Armani casts [Hangarback Walker] with X = 3. Can Neriah counter it with [Thoughtbind]?
answer_gold: No. The mana value of a spell is determined by adding together the symbols in the upper right corner of the card. The mana value of Hangarback Walker on the stack is 6.

question: Avery casts [Sram's Expertise]. As it resolves, they would like tap the tokens it created to cast [Collective Effort] escalated twice. Can they?
answer_gold: Yes. The instructions of a resolving spell are carried out in the order written, so the tokens will be on the battlefield at that time. Tapping creatures for escalate is an additional cost. ([702.120a]) Avery may still pay an additional cost for Collective Effort while casting it for the alternative cost given to it by Sram's Expertise.

question: Nikolas controls [Mindcrank]. Ari casts [Vampiric Tutor]. Will the card Ari put on top of their library get milled?
answer_gold: Yes. Mindcrank triggers during the resolution of Vampiric Tutor and will be put onto the stack after Vampiric Tutor finishes resolving. (Ari can cast an instant before the trigger resolves.)

question: Does Nicole have a chance to cast [Surgical Extraction] after Addison has drawn for turn but before they have a chance to cast a sorcery?
answer_gold: Yes. Players receive priority in the draw step after a card has been drawn.

question: Ashley controls [Frogtosser Banneret]. Will it affect the cost of [Knowledge Exploitation]?
answer_gold: Yes. Knowledge Exploitation is a Rogue.

question: Amir casts [Archon of Cruelty], and before it resolves Norah casts [Surge of Salvation]. What happens when the Archon resolves?
answer_gold: Archon of Cruelty's ability triggers but is not placed onto the stack, since there are no legal targets for it. Amir will not draw a card or gain life.

question: Adelynn controls [Clockwork Beast] which has one +1/+0 counter on it. They want to activate its ability with X = 8. Can they?
answer_gold: Yes, but when it resolves Adelynn can't choose to put the full 8 +1/+0 counters on it; only up to 6.

question: Naomi has 7 life and controls two [Death's Shadow]s. Angelo uses [Ajani Unyielding] to exile one of the Death's Shadows. What happens next?
answer_gold: Death's Shadow is a 6/6 when it gets exiled, so Naomi gains 6 life. Before Angelo receives priority again, state-based actions are checked, and the game sees that the remaining Death's Shadow now has 0 toughness, and it will be put into Naomi's graveyard.

question: Aniyah currently controls Nico's commander. Can Aniyah cast [Fierce Guardianship] for its alternative cost?
answer_gold: Yes. Fierce Guardianship alternative cost works if Aniyah controls any commander, not necessarily theirs.

question: Nia controls [Hollowhenge Huntmaster]. Anders casts [Flesh Duplicate]. Can they have it enter the battlefield as a copy of Hollowhenge Huntmaster?
answer_gold: Yes. Hexproof prevents Hollowhenge Huntmaster from being the target of an opponent's spell or ability, but Flesh Duplicate doesn't target anything.

question: Ada casts [Shaman of the Pack]. In response to its trigger, Nickolas kills it with [Foolish Fate]. How much life does Nickolas lose?
answer_gold: 0. When Shaman of the Pack's trigger resolves, Ada controls no Elves.

question: In a Commander game, how much life does each player begin the game with?
Amina attacks with [Retaliation]. Nico declares no blocks and then casts [Curtain of Light] targeting Retaliation. Does Retaliation trigger?
answer_gold: No. Retaliation became blocked, but not by any creatures.

question: Ariel controls [Rest in Peace] and targets Nataly's [Dauthi Voidwalker] with [Lightning Bolt]. What happens to each card?
answer_gold:
Ariel chooses whether Lightning Bolt goes to exile with or without a counter.

There are two replacement effects attempting to replace Lightning Bolt going to the graveyard with it going to exile, so its controller gets to choose which to apply.

Then state-based actions are checked and Dauthi Voidwalker is put into exile.

question: Ainsley and Noor are starting a two-player game. Ainsley decides to keep their hand of 7 cards. Noor decides to mulligan. Can Ainsley now decide to mulligan?
answer_gold: No.

question: Anahi casts [Aura Mutation] targeting Nehemiah's [Leyline of the Void]. Will Aura Mutation go to Anahi's graveyard or exile?
answer_gold: Graveyard. Leyline of the Void is destroyed before Aura Mutation goes to the graveyard, since going to the graveyard is the last part of a spell resolving.

question: Ari controls [Omnath, Locus of Creation] and [Elesh Norn, Mother of Machines]. They play [Tainted Peak]. What happens?
answer_gold: Omnath, Locus of Creation's ability triggers twice. The first instance of the ability will cause Ari to gain 4 life and the second instance will add {R}{G}{U}{W} to their mana pool. Elesh Norn, Mother of Machines will cause the ability to trigger twice since it triggers as the result of a permanent entering the battlefield. Omnath, Locus of Creation's triggered ability has an effect depending on how many times its resolved this turn, so the second instance that resolves will have the second effect.

question: Amiya controls [Fetid Gargantua] with two +1/+1 counters on it. Nico controls [Soul-Scar Mage] and casts [Scorching Lava] targeting Fetid Gargantua. After Scorching Lava resolves, can Fetid Gargantua adapt again?
answer_gold: Yes. If a permanent has both -1/-1 and +1/+1 counters on it, they are removed as a state-based action. Adapt checks the number of +1/+1 counters on Fetid Gargantua as it resolves, it doesn't matter if it's been activated in the past.

question: Ari controls [Emeria Shepherd]. They play [Sacred Peaks], and target [Garenbrig Carver] in their graveyard. In response, Noelle activates [Alchemist's Refuge]. When that ability resolves, they casts [Blood Moon]. When Emeria Shepherd's ability resolves, where is Garenbrig Carver?
answer_gold:
Ari's hand.

Blood Moon changes Sacred Peaks's subtypes to "Mountain", and Sacred Peaks loses all other subtypes. During the resolution of the ability, Sacred Peaks is no longer a Plains and therefore Garenbrig Carver will not return to the battlefield.

question: Ainsley controls [General Ferrous Rokiric]. What happens when they cast [Illusion]?
answer_gold: General Ferrous Rokiric won't trigger. While Illusion is a multicolored card elsewhere, on the stack it's a monocolored card.

question:
Aydan casts [Kellan, the Fae-Blooded], and Nico answers by casting [Spell Queller], exiling Kellan, the Fae-Blooded with its triggered ability.
When Spell Queller leaves the battlefield, can Aydan choose to cast [Birthright Boon] or do they have to cast Kellan, the Fae-Blooded?
answer_gold: Aydan can choose to cast either Kellan, the Fae-Blooded or Birthright Boon when Spell Queller leaves the battlefield.

question: Can Nicolas cast [Memory Lapse] targeting Aubrianna's [Underworld Charger] that is escaping from their graveyard?
answer_gold: Yes. Escape is an alternative cost ([702.138a]), which means that once paid the escaped spell is on the stack, and can be interacted with as normal. Countering a spell means to remove that spell from the stack before it resolves. Underworld Charger is a legal target for Memory Lapse.

question: Ariyah has [Guardian Naga] in their graveyard. Can they flash back Guardian Naga's Adventure with [Flashback]?
answer_gold: No. An Adventure defines alternative characteristics the card can have when cast as an Adventure. Adventurer cards only have their normal characteristics in every zone other than the stack, so it's not a legal target for Flashback.

question: Ace controls [Sarkhan, the Dragonspeaker] and activates its ability, turning it into a creature. They then play a second Sarkhan, the Dragonspeaker. What happens when the second Sarkhan, the Dragonspeaker resolves?
answer_gold: As soon as the spell finishes resolving, state-based actions are checked and Ace will need to choose one Sarkhan, the Dragonspeaker to put into their graveyard. Regardless of what card type they are, both Sarkhan, the Dragonspeaker are legendary permanents with the same name, and therefore the 'legend rule' applies.

question: Ainsley controls [Reconnaissance] and attacks Nancy with [Loxodon Wayfarer]. After combat damage is dealt, can Ainsley use Reconnaissance's activated ability to untap Loxodon Wayfarer?
answer_gold: Yes. Loxodon Wayfarer is considered an attacking creature until the end of the combat phase, and is therefore still a legal target for Reconnaissance's activated ability.

question: Arjun controls [Thermopod] and has no cards in their graveyard. Assuming they have enough mana, can they activate [Molten-Tail Masticore]'s first activated ability?
answer_gold: Yes. Arjun first puts the ability onto the stack, after which it won't matter if Molten-Tail Masticore is on the battlefield anymore. Arjun then has a chance to activate mana abilities, at which point they can sacrifice Molten-Tail Masticore. Then Arjun pays the cost of the spell, exiling Molten-Tail Masticore from their graveyard.

question: Can Ashley pay {B}{B}{B}{B}{B}{B} to cast [Beseech the Queen] or is Ashley limited to only paying {B}{B}{B} to do so?
answer_gold: After the first step of casting a spell, which is announcing it and moving it to the stack, Ashley makes choices regarding modes, alternative costs, additional costs, etc. This step includes deciding whether they will be paying {B} or {2} for each hybrid symbol ({2/B}) in Beseech the Queen's mana cost. They may always choose to cast it for {6} instead of {B}{B}{B} (or {2}{B}{B} or {4}{B}). Later on during the casting of the spell, the colorless parts of the mana cost may be paid with any color, including black.

question: Arielle has [Blessed Hippogriff] in their graveyard. Arielle casts [Mission Briefing], can they choose to cast the adventure of Blessed Hippogriff?
answer_gold: No. Adventurer cards have an alternative set of characteristics, however any time an Adventurer card is anywhere other than the stack it only has the characteristics of the creature portion. Mission Briefing requires Arielle to choose an instant or sorcery card in their graveyard, and they cannot choose Blessed Hippogriff.

question: Neriah controls [Cliffhaven Sell-Sword]. Ari casts [Oubliette] targeting it. Will Cliffhaven Sell-Sword phase back in at the beginning of Neriah's next untap step?
answer_gold: No. Effects that phase a permanent out until a certain event prevent that permanent from phasing back in normally.

question: Nico controls [Lazav, the Multifarious], which is currently a copy of [Lazav, Dimir Mastermind]. Abram discards [Kasimir the Lone Wolf] due to hand size at the end of their turn. Lazav, the Multifarious's ability triggers. After it resolves, what is Lazav, the Multifarious named?
answer_gold: "Lazav, Dimir Mastermind". Lazav, Dimir Mastermind's ability changes the card's name to "Lazav, Dimir Mastermind", regardless of what it was originally named.

question: Alivia has [Road // Ruin] in their graveyard. Alivia casts [Torrential Gearhulk]. Which side of Road // Ruin can Alivia cast with its trigger?
answer_gold: Either side. Torrential Gearhulk has a targeting restriction that requires Alivia to select an instant in their graveyard. Split cards have the type of both sides simultaneously. Therefore Road // Ruin is both an instant and a sorcery card and satisfies the targeting restriction on Torrential Gearhulk. When Alivia goes to cast Road // Ruin, nothing cares about which half is cast, so either is legal.

question: Alvaro controls [Draugr Thought-Thief] and [Lotusguard Disciple]. Nico controls [Sands of Time] and [Yurlok of Scorch Thrash]. If Alvaro casts [Zagras, Thief of Heartbeats], can they choose to only have the cost reduced by {1}?
answer_gold: No. Zagras, Thief of Heartbeats's cost is reduced by the number of creatures in Alvaro's party, which is determined by the game, and is calculated to be the highest possible amount.

question: Adriel controls [Oko, Thief of Crowns], [Gilded Goose], and a Food token. Adriel uses Oko, Thief of Crowns's +1 ability to make the Food token into a 3/3 Elk. Can Adriel then sacrifice it to Gilded Goose?
answer_gold: No. Oko, Thief of Crowns's ability is a type-changing effect which will overwrite any previous types and subtypes the object had. When Gilded Goose asks Adriel to sacrifice a Food, it is saying that Adriel needs to sacrifice a permanent with the subtype "Food".

question: Natasha controls a [Lifeline] and 2 [Scarwood Goblins]. Adriel casts [Plague Wind]. Does Lifeline trigger and return the creatures to the battlefield at the beginning of the next end step?
answer_gold: No. Leaves-the-battlefield triggers care about the game state immediately before the event in question occurred when determining whether they trigger. There was another creature on the battlefield at that time, so Lifeline will trigger for both creatures that died. However, Lifeline has an intervening "if" clause that checks for that condition again as the trigger begins to resolve. There is not another creature on the battlefield at that time, so the ability is removed from the stack. Neither Scarwood Goblins returns to the battlefield.

question: Alfred casts [Stream of Thought], replicating it twice. Nico controls [Chalice of the Void] with 1 charge counter. What happens?
answer_gold: The original Stream of Thought is countered, the two copies resolve as normal. Replicate and Chalice of the Void both trigger when the spell is cast. Since the Chalice of the Void trigger is controlled by the player last in turn order, it will resolve first, countering Stream of Thought. Then Stream of Thought's trigger resolves and creates two copies of Stream of Thought. The copies are not cast, so they don't trigger Chalice of the Void.

question: Adrienne attacks with [Sporeweb Weaver], and Nicolas blocks it with [Serpent Assassin]. Can Nicolas use [Tishana's Tidebinder] to counter Sporeweb Weaver's ability?
answer_gold: Yes. Tishana's Tidebinder's ability targets Sporeweb Weaver's ability, not Sporeweb Weaver itself, so hexproof doesn't matter.

question: Autumn controls [Captain Mar-Vell, Space-Born] and casts [Tempted by the Oriq] targeting Breanna's and Case's Soldier tokens. Before it resolves, Autumn casts [Insurrection]. What happens?
answer_gold: Insurrection resolves and Autumn gains control of all the Soldier tokens. Then Tempted by the Oriq begins to resolve, but its targets are now illegal, so it does not resolve and is removed from the stack.

question: Amelia casts [Aminatou's Augury] exiling an artifact and an instant. Afterwards Amelia casts another Aminatou's Augury, which exiles an instant. Can they cast both instants?
answer_gold: Yes. Each Aminatou's Augury creates a separate effect that applies to cards it exiled. Casting an instant off the first Aminatou's Augury doesn't preclude Amelia from casting an instant off the second one.

question: Agustin casts [Seasoned Pyromancer] and has two other cards in hand, one of which is a land card. Nico controls [Leyline of the Void]. How many tokens are created?
answer_gold: One token is created. The cards discarded from hand can still be seen by Seasoned Pyromancer's effect even though going to the graveyard was replaced by going to exile.

question: Aranza controls a [Welding Jar] enchanted by Nico's [Curse Artifact]. In response to the trigger during Aranza's upkeep, Nico casts [Word of Seizing] to take control of the Welding Jar. What happens as the trigger resolves?
answer_gold: Aranza is dealt 2 damage. Sacrificing the Welding Jar is a cost. If the cost isn't paid, the default action of dealing 2 damage to Aranza happens. Aranza cannot sacrifice a permanent that they don't control.

question: Alina controls a [Valakut, the Molten Pinnacle] and 5 [Mountain]s. They plays a 6th Mountain and target Nico with Valakut, the Molten Pinnacle's trigger. In response, Nico activates [Memorial to War], targeting the Valakut, the Molten Pinnacle. Will they be dealt 3 damage?
answer_gold: Yes. Removing the source of an ability on the stack does not affect that ability.

question: Arely equips [Barbed Batterfist] onto [Champion of the Flame]. Does Champion of the Flame die?
answer_gold: No, Champion of the Flame will be a 4/2 and not die. All continuous effects are applied instantly before state based actions are checked.

question: Aviana controls a [Meng Huo's Horde] and a [Deathrite Shaman]. Nico controls a [Propaganda]. Can Aviana use Deathrite Shaman's ability to pay for the Meng Huo's Horde to attack?
answer_gold: No. Propaganda imposes a cost on Meng Huo's Horde attacking, which must be paid as a part of declaring it as an attacker. Deathrite Shaman's ability is not a mana ability, so the last time it could be activated before attackers are declared is during the beginning of combat step. At the end of that step, the mana would empty from Aviana's mana pool.

question: Amos casts [Rise from the Grave] targeting [Rhizome Lurcher] in their graveyard. Assuming there are no other cards in any graveyards, how many +1/+1 counters will Rhizome Lurcher enter the battlefield with?
answer_gold: One. Rhizome Lurcher has a replacement effect that modifies how it will enter the battlefield. The game needs to know how Rhizome Lurcher will enter the battlefield, and must do that before it enters the battlefield. At that point it will be in the graveyard and will count itself.

question: Ava controls [Undead Minotaur] enchanted with [Shade's Form]. Nico casts [Hour of Revelation] to destroy both Undead Minotaur and Shade's Form. Will Undead Minotaur return to the battlefield?
answer_gold: Yes. Shade's Form has a triggered ability that occurs when the enchanted permanent dies. For most triggers the game checks to see if they occur right after every event. However for "dies" triggers the game checks what the game state looked like right before they triggered to see if they trigger. In this case, checking right before Hour of Revelation resolved results in Shade's Form triggering and returning Undead Minotaur to the battlefield.

question: Amara controls [Muraganda Petroglyphs] and [Wayward Angel], and has more than 7 cards in their graveyard. Nehemiah casts and resolves [Humility]. What are Wayward Angel's characteristics?
answer_gold:
Wayward Angel is a Black, 6/6 creature with no abilities. The rest of its characteristics remain the same as printed on the card. 
Wayward Angel's threshold ability changes both its color, abilities, and P/T. Therefore, it applies in layers 5, 6, and 7 with the appropriate parts applying in their appropriate layers, and the layers are applied in order. Similarly, Humility's effect is applied in layers 6 and 7, as appropriate. 
Applying layers in order:
- In layer 5, Wayward Angel becomes black. 
- In layer 6 there are two contending effects: Wayward Angel's ability giving it trample and an upkeep triggered ability, and Humility's ability removing all abilities from Wayward Angel. There is no dependency between the two, since Wayward Angel's ability has already started applying in a previous layer, and will continue to apply even if removed by Humility's ability. The effects are then applied in timestamp order with Wayward Angel's ability applying first, since it has an earlier timestamp. So in layer 6, Wayward Angel first gains trample and "At the beginning of your upkeep, sacrifice a creature.", and then loses all abilities to Humility.
- In layer 7, P/T setting effects are applied first, so that Humility first turns Wayward Angel into a 1/1. Then effects modifying P/T are applied, of which there are two: Wayward Angel's own ability that, even though removed, continues to apply and gives it +3/+3, and Muraganda Petroglyphs's ability giving Wayward Angel +2/+2 since it now has no abilities. Wayward Angel's P/T is finally 6/6.

question: Nayeli controls [Trinisphere]. Ainsley casts [Noxious Revival], paying 2 life for the Phyrexian mana. What is the total cost of the Noxious Revival?
answer_gold: {3} and 2 life. While casting Noxious Revival, Ainsley chooses whether to pay life or mana for each Phyrexian mana symbol in the cost. Trinisphere is applied afterwards and increases the cost up to the minimum of 3 mana.

question: Anakin controls [Mycosynth Lattice], an [Animate Dead] attached to a [Maritime Guard] that it returned to the battlefield, and a [Mizzium Transreliquat] that is currently a copy of [Sakashima of a Thousand Faces] due to its second ability. Anakin casts [Clever Impersonator], choosing to copy the Mizzium Transreliquat and then choosing to copy the Animate Dead with its new copy ability as it enters the battlefield. They choose to enchant a [Balduvian Barbarians] in their graveyard. After Clever Impersonator's trigger resolves and returns the Balduvian Barbarians to the battlefield, Anakin activates the ability of the Clever Impersonator to turn it into a copy of Maritime Guard. What happens?
answer_gold: This can't happen as described. When Clever Impersonator enters the battlefield and copies Sakashima of a Thousand Faces, it then hard Sakashima of a Thousand Faces's ability to enter the battlefield as a copy of a creature, but it's attempting to copy an enchantment. This is illegal, since Sakashima of a Thousand Faces can only copy creatures, not enchantments.

question: Amare casts [Insatiable Hemophage] targeting [Canal Monitor] to mutate unto it. Can Nico cast [Withering Boon] to counter Insatiable Hemophage?
answer_gold: Yes, Nico can use Withering Boon to counter Insatiable Hemophage if it was cast for the mutate cost. A spell that was cast for a mutate cost is still a creature spell and, therefore, can be countered by Withering Boon. ([702.140a])

question: Amirah controls Azors Gateway with 4 different CMC cards exiled by it. They targets it with [Karn's Touch]. After that resolves, they activates [Azor's Gateway], and transforms it into [Sanctum of the Sun]. What are the characteristics of the new object after it has transformed?
answer_gold: Sanctum of the Sun is a 2/2 Legendary artifact creature land with the ability "{T}: Add X mana of any one color, where X is your life total". The requirement that Azor's Gateway be an artifact is part of the targeting restriction of the spell, after the spell resolves, it creates a continuous effect on the permanent that was targeted (in this case Azor's Gateway) that lasts until end of turn. When a double-faced card transforms it doesn't become a new object, and any effects that applied to it before the transformation will continue to apply afterwards.

question: Aryana controls [Ascended Lawmage] and [Cemetery Gate]. Nicholas controls [Onakke Ogre] enchanted by their [Paralyze]. Aryana casts [Sudden Disappearance] targeting Nicholas. When the trigger resolves at the beginning of the next end step, what can Paralyze enchant?
answer_gold: Just Ascended Lawmage. Cemetery Gate has protection from black, so it can't be enchanted by anything black. Onakke Ogre isn't on the battlefield when Nicholas chooses what to enchant. Hexproof doesn't prevent an Aura from becoming attached to the Ascended Lawmage.

question: Amaris controls [Eruth, Tormented Prophet] and, during their draw step, they attempt to dredge [Golgari Grave-Troll]. What happens?
answer_gold: Amaris can dredge Golgari Grave-Troll instead of drawing. There are two replacement effects attempting to replace Amaris's draw. Since they are the affected player, they choose whether to exile the card with Eruth, Tormented Prophet or dredge with Golgari Grave-Troll. Once one of the replacement effects has been applied, the "draw" event no longer exists, and the other replacement effect does not apply.

question: Nicole controls [Oraxid]. Can Austin cast [First Volley] targeting Oraxid with [Evermind] spliced onto it?
answer_gold: No. Evermind has a color indicator making it blue, which is not granted by splice since it's not part of the card's text.

question: Aubrey controls [Gisa and Geralf] and has cast a spell with it this turn. They casts [Acrobatic Maneuver], targeting the Gisa and Geralf. After it resolves, can they cast another card from their graveyard?
answer_gold: Yes. Gisa and Geralf's effect allows Aubrey to cast one spell with that effect. If the Gisa and Geralf leaves the battlefield and then returns, it is a completely new object, generating a new effect. That effect counts no cards cast with it yet this turn.

question: In a game of commander, Natasha has shuffled their commander into their library. Adan casts [Praetor's Grasp] targeting Natasha and finds Natasha's commander. Can Natasha choose to put it into the command zone?
answer_gold: Yes. Despite being face-down, it's still Natasha's commander, and they can choose to have it move to the command zone as a state-based action.

question: Nico controls [Lion's Eye Diamond]. Addison casts [Wipe Away] targeting the Lion's Eye Diamond. Can Nico activate it in response?
answer_gold: Yes. Lion's Eye Diamond's ability is a mana ability. Split second does not prevent mana abilities from being activated. "Activate only as an instant" simply means that Nico must have priority, not that Nico could actually cast an instant at that time.

question: Avah controls [Dakmor Scorpion] and [Winding Constrictor]. Nelson casts [Cannibalize] targeting them both. When it resolves, they choose to exile Winding Constrictor and to put +1/+1 counters on Dakmor Scorpion. How many +1/+1 counters are placed on Dakmor Scorpion?
answer_gold: 2. Spells resolve in the order printed on the card. Winding Constrictor is exiled before placing the counters on Dakmor Scorpion.

question: Alex controls [Rhythm of the Wild], [Grumgully, the Generous], [Renata, Called to the Hunt], and [Hardened Scales]. Alex then casts [Grizzled Outrider]. If they chooses to put a counter on Grizzled Outrider for Rhythm of the Wild, how many +1/+1 counters will it enter with in total?
answer_gold: Four. Every card on the battlefield has a replacement effect that modifies how Grizzled Outrider will enter the battlefield. When applying replacement effects, each effect has a chance to apply once and only once, so even though Alex can choose which order to apply the effects in, Hardened Scales will only get one chance to modify how many counters Grizzled Outrider enters the battlefield with, and will only ever add one additional counter.

question: Ann has a [Sphere of Resistance], a Plains and a Swamp. Can Ann cast [Prismatic Ending] targeting [Drake Familiar]?
answer_gold: Yes Ann can cast Prismatic Ending targeting Drake Familiar. Ann can target Drake Familiar regardless of whether the final spell will exile it or not, as any card is targetable with Prismatic Ending, and it's only exiled if the conditions are met. Then Ann chooses the value of X, in this case they can select 0, then add Sphere of Resistance's tax resulting in a required mana payment of two. If Ann chooses to use two different colors of mana, when the spell resolves it will see that two colors were spent and exile the target if it's mana value is two or less.

question: Abram attacks with [Robber of the Rich], exiling [Skewer the Critics] from Nico's library. Can Abram pay Skewer the Critics's Spectacle cost with only {C}?
answer_gold:
Yes.

Robber of the Rich allows Abram to cast the card and "may spend mana as though it were mana of any color to cast that spell." This changes how the player may pay a cost, and they can do so with any mana, regardless of color. 

"Spectacle" is an alternative cost ([702.137a]), and can only be used if no other alternative cost is being paid. Luckily, Robber of the Rich does not create an alternative cost, it just changes how mana may be spent.

question: Aspen controls [Haakon, Stromgald Scourge] and has [Foulmire Knight] in their graveyard. Can Aspen cast the Adventure portion of Foulmire Knight from their graveyard?
answer_gold: No. When determining if it's legal to begin casting a spell by moving it to the stack with Haakon, Stromgald Scourge, the game takes into account any alternative characteristics it would have on the stack. Haakon, Stromgald Scourge does not permit Aspen to move an Adventure to the stack, since it's not a Knight.

question: Ayaan controls [Essence of the Wild] and casts [Evil Twin]. Can they have the Evil Twin enter the battlefield as a copy of Nico's [Quakestrider Ceratops]?
answer_gold: No. Essence of the Wild and Evil Twin both have replacement effects that want to modify how Evil Twin enters the battlefield. Ayaan, as the affected player, may apply them in whatever order they wishes. Unfortunately neither order will result in Evil Twin entering as a copy of Quakestrider Ceratops. If they applies Evil Twin first, that ability will set Evil Twin's copiable values to those of Quakestrider Ceratops. Then Essence of the Wild will set them to its own copiable values. If they applies Essence of the Wild first, that will set Evil Twin's copiable values to Essence of the Wild. This will overwrite Evil Twin's ability, so it will no longer apply.

question: Alex controls [Obosh, the Preypiercer] and casts their last card, [Flame Spill], targeting a 1/1 creature that Nevaeh controls. How much damage will Nevaeh take?
answer_gold: Six. First Alex will allocate one damage to the token and three to Nevaeh. Obosh, the Preypiercer's replacement effect will then double the three damage being dealt to Nevaeh to six.

question: Alessandro activates [Inkmoth Nexus] to turn it into a creature and attacks Noor with it. Noor doesn't block it and then casts [Through the Breach], putting [Melira, Sylvok Outcast] onto the battlefield. What happens during the combat damage step?
answer_gold:
Inkmoth Nexus's ability gives it infect, and Melira, Sylvok Outcast's effect makes it lose infect. The effects are applied in timestamp order, so Inkmoth Nexus does not have infect. Noor will lose 1 life when damage is dealt.

(There is no dependency here because neither effect changes the text or the existence of the other, what it applies to, or what it does to any of the things it applies to.)

question: Alex controls [Extus, Oriq Overlord] and uses [Illithid Harvester] to try to turn it face down. What happens?
answer_gold: Nothing happens. Double-faced permanents can't be turned face down.

question: Autumn controls [Jibbirik Omnivore], a token copy of Jibbirik Omnivore produced by [Stolen Identity], a 1/1 Saproling token created by [Morbid Bloom], [Moonscarred Werewolf], and a token copy of Moonscarred Werewolf produced by [Twinflame]. Nash casts [Ratchet Bomb] and activates its second ability. As Ratchet Bomb's ability resolves, what is destroyed?
answer_gold: The Saproling token and the token copy of Moonscarred Werewolf. Copy effects copy mana cost, so the token Jibbirik Omnivore doesn't have a mana value of 0. Tokens that are created by an effect that sets their characteristics only have those characteristics. The Saproling token has no mana cost, so its mana value is 0. The mana value of transformed transforming double-faced cards is determined by their front face, so the Moonscarred Werewolf isn't destroyed. Copies of double-faced cards have a mana value of 0.

question: Ayla controls [Living Plane] and plays [Minas Tirith]. Does it enter tapped or untapped?
answer_gold: Tapped. When applying an enters-the-battlefield replacement effect, the game considers the characteristics of the permanent as it would exist on the battlefield, so it sees that it would be a creature, but it doesn't consider the permanent to actually be on the battlefield yet. Effectively, a legendary creature is entering the battlefield.

question: Andy controls [Badlands] and [Conversion]. Andy then casts [Magus of the Moon]. After that resolves, what color(s) of mana can Badlands tap for?
answer_gold: Only {R}. Both Magus of the Moon and Conversion only apply in layer 4. The effects are applied in timestamp order, resulting in Conversion applying first to make Badlands a Plains, then Magus of the Moon applies making it a Mountain.

question: Amy controls a [Trigon of Corruption] enchanted by Neil's [Curse Artifact]. In response to the trigger during Amy's upkeep, they cast [Aura Graft] to attach the Curse Artifact to [Sungrass Egg]. Which artifact does Amy have the choice to sacrifice as the trigger resolves?
answer_gold: Trigon of Corruption. The "that artifact" that the trigger on the stack refers to is the one that Curse Artifact was attached to as the ability triggered.

question: Nico controls [Blind Obedience]. Adonis's devotion to black is 0 and they cast [Erebos, God of the Dead]. Does it enter the battlefield tapped or untapped?
answer_gold: Untapped. To determine what replacement effects apply to a permanent as it enters the battlefield, the game looks at the permanent as it would exist on the battlefield. On the battlefield Erebos, God of the Dead would not be a creature, so Blind Obedience's effect will not apply to it.

question: Alex casts [Brainstorm] using the ability of [Jace, Telepath Unbound]. Nina casts [Memory Lapse] and counters Brainstorm. Where does Brainstorm go?
answer_gold:
Alex's library.

Two replacement effects are trying to replace the same event. Since Memory Lapse's effect is a self-replacement effect, it applies first. Once it's applied, Brainstorm is moving to the library and Jace, Telepath Unbound's effect no longer applies.

question: Nathalia controls [Welding Jar] and [Duskworker]. Ariel casts [Prismari Command], choosing the "deal 2 damage" and "destroy target artifact" modes, targeting Duskworker with both. In response, Nathalia activates Welding Jar's ability targeting Duskworker. What happens?
answer_gold: Duskworker will end up tapped and have no damage marked on it. Welding Jar's ability will resolve first, regenerating Duskworker. When Prismari Command resolves, the game carries out the instructions in the order written. First, Prismari Command deals 2 damage to Duskworker. The replacement effect generated by the regeneration ability will not apply yet, as even though Duskworker has been dealt lethal damage, it would only be destroyed when state-based actions are checked, and state-based actions are checked when a player would get priority. Next Prismari Command tries to destroy Duskworker and the replacement effect applies, replacing the destruction event with Duskworker being tapped and having all damaged marked on it removed. Lastly Prismari Command finishes resolving and leaves the stack and state-based actions are checked. Since Duskworker no longer has any damage marked on it, it will not be die.

question: Armando controls [Mana Reflection] and taps [Pyromancer's Goggles] to add {R}{R}. They spend one mana to cast [Into the Fray]. Later in the phase they spend the other mana to cast [Galvanic Discharge]. Which one(s) are copied?
answer_gold: Both are copied. Mana Reflection has a replacement effect that changes the amount of mana produced by Pyromancer's Goggles. A separate delayed trigger is created for each mana.

question: Alden controls [Spark Double] and casts [Clone]. Alden would like to have Clone copy Spark Double, then they would like to apply the replacement effect Clone inherited from Spark Double and have it copy Spark Double again. If Alden has Clone copy Spark Double a total of four times, how many +1/+1 counters will Clone enter the battlefield with?
answer_gold: One. Spark Double has a copy effect that includes an exception (entering with a +1/+1 counter). If another copy effect is applied afterwards, the exception from the first effect will not happen.

question: Ahmed casts [Bitter Ordeal], targeting Nico. At their first opportunity, Ahmed sacrifices their [Abandoned Outpost]. How many cards will Ahmed be able to exile from Nico's library?
answer_gold: 2. Gravestorm cares about the number of permanents put into the graveyard before the trigger resolves.

question: Autumn restarts the game with [Karn Liberated]'s last ability. They put a [Quilled Slagwurm] onto the battlefield as it resolves. Can it attack on their first turn?
answer_gold: Yes. Karn's ability finishes resolving just before the first turn's untap step, so the creature has been controlled continuously since the turn began and can attack.

question: Abel plays [Exotic Orchard]. What can it tap for if Nico controls only [Throne of Makindi] without any charge counters on it?
answer_gold: Any color of mana. Exotic Orchard is limited by what an opponent's land's abilities could produce if they resolved, not if the opponent could pay the costs required.

question: Abraham controls [Drought] and [Derelor]. How many Swamps would they have to sacrifice in order to cast a [Virulent Wound]?
answer_gold: 1. The mana cost of a spell doesn't change, regardless of what was paid for it.

question: Abram controls a [Blood Moon], a [Life and Limb], and a [Tropical Island], that entered the battlefield in that order. Is the Tropical Island a creature?
answer_gold: No. Applying Blood Moon's effect first would prevent Life and Limb's effect from applying to Tropical Island and applying Life and Limb's effect first would not affect how Blood Moon's effect is applied or what it does, so Life and Limb's effect is dependent on Blood Moon's effect and waits to apply until afterwards. Since Blood Moon's effect makes Tropical Island no longer a Forest, Life and Limb doesn't apply to it at all.

question: Nixon has a [Southern Elephant] and a [Skullbriar, the Walking Grave] with 3 +1/+1 counters in their graveyard. Addison casts [Ghastly Conscription], targeting Nixon. What happens to the counters on the Skullbriar, the Walking Grave? Will Nixon know which manifested card is which?
answer_gold: When in the graveyard, Skullbriar, the Walking Grave had the ability that allowed it to keep its counters, so it is exiled and shuffled with 3 +1/+1 counters. When it's moved to the battlefield, it's face down and no longer has that ability, so the counters cease to exist. It had the counters immediately before entering the battlefield however, so Nixon will know which face-down permanent is the Skullbriar, the Walking Grave and which is the Southern Elephant.

question: Asa casts [Chatterstorm]. In response, Nico casts [Gather Specimens]. After everything resolves, Asa activates the second ability of [Homeward Path]. Who gains control of the token?
answer_gold: Asa does. Tokens are owned by the player that created them. Asa still created the token, regardless of under whose control it entered the battlefield.

question: Aaliyah controls a [Squandered Resources] and a [Glacial Floodplain]. Nicolas controls [Blood Moon]. If Aaliyah sacrifices Glacial Floodplain to Squandered Resources, what type(s) of mana can it produce?
answer_gold: Just {R}. Squandered Resources cares about what colors of mana it could produce on the battlefield.

question: Neil controls [Willow Elf] enchanted with [Felidar Umbra]. Ainsley casts [Anger of the Gods]. What happens?
answer_gold: Felidar Umbra is destroyed and moves to the graveyard. Willow Elf remains on the battlefield. If it would die later in the turn, it'll be exiled instead. Felidar Umbra's effect replaces the "destroy" event while Anger of the Gods's effect replaces the "die" event, so Felidar Umbra has to be applied first.

question: Asa controls [Library of Leng] and is discarding a card due to [Azra Oddsmaker]'s ability. Can they put the discarded card on top of their library? If so, what happens?
answer_gold: Yes. Discarding a cost to the ability is a cost [118.12], but that doesn't stop it from being an effect as well. Library of Leng only changes where the card moves to, not that it was discarded, so the cost was paid and the remainder of Azra Oddsmaker's ability will resolve as normal.

question: Noah controls [Compost]. Ainsley controls [Dune Beetle] and a token that was created as a copy of [Bogstomper]. Ainsley casts [Soulscour]. How many times does Compost trigger?
answer_gold:
0. Soulscour destroys all permanents simultaneously. Compost's trigger checks immediately after the event in question to see if it should trigger. However by that time Compost is in the graveyard, and its ability doesn't function there.

(Compost doesn't fit the "leaves-the-battlefield" trigger exception because it's a "from anywhere" trigger.)

question: Noor controls [Rhystic Study]. Alex casts [Mishra's Domination]. As Rhystic Study's trigger resolves, who makes their choice first? Does Noor choose whether or not to draw a card, and if yes, Alex may pay the mana to prevent it? Or does Alex choose to pay the mana first, and if they don't, Noor has the choice to draw a card?
answer_gold: Alex chooses first.

question: Allison controls [Leyline of Anticipation]. In their draw step, they casts [Relentless Assault]. What happens?
answer_gold: There is no "this main phase" to add the combat step after, so no additional phase is created. The turn proceeds as normal.

question: Albert, Brielle, and Campbell are playing a multiplayer game. Brielle controls [Stalking Leonin]. Albert casts [Worst Fears] to take control of Brielle's next turn. After Brielle begins their turn, can Albert see which player was chosen for the Stalking Leonin?
answer_gold: No. The choice was made as Stalking Leonin entered the battlefield, which already happened- it's no longer visible to Brielle. Albert can choose to activate the ability (at which point all players will know who was chosen), but otherwise the choice is not visible to any player.

question: Abdullah controls [Primal Vigor] and casts [Rescuer Sphinx], choosing to return Primal Vigor to their hand. How many +1/+1 counters will Rescuer Sphinx enter the battlefield with?
answer_gold: Two. Both cards have a replacement effect. Abdullah will choose whether they are returning a permanent, but won't actually complete the action until Rescuer Sphinx enters the battlefield. Therefore Primal Vigor will still apply to the +1/+1 counter being from Rescuer Sphinx's ability.

question: Arturo uses [Vengeful Ancestor] to goad [Craw Wurm]. After it's been goaded, Nico uses [Brokers Confluence], causing Craw Wurm to phase out. On Nico's turn, what are Nico's legal combat choices?
answer_gold: Craw Wurm must attack, and since there aren't any other players in the game, it has to attack Arturo. Goaded creatures must attack, and must attack a player other than the one that goaded them if able. Phasing doesn't cause Craw Wurm to no longer be goaded, as the duration on the continuous effect hasn't ended when Craw Wurm phases back in.

question: Arabella controls [Sylvok Explorer]. Nolan controls [Gaea's Cradle] and no creatures. If Arabella taps the Sylvok Explorer, what type(s) of mana can they produce?
answer_gold: None. Gaea's Cradle couldn't produce any mana, so neither can Sylvok Explorer.

question: Addisyn casts [Read the Runes] for X=2 and chooses to discard a card and sacrifice [All-Seeing Arbiter]. Will All-Seeing Arbiter trigger?
answer_gold: No. Addisyn will first choose whether they are sacrificing permanent, if they don't then they discard a card. Because it happens in this order, All-Seeing Arbiter will not be around to when Addisyn is discarding a card.

question: Addison has six cards in their graveyard and casts [Epicenter] targeting Nataly. In response, Nataly casts [Blossoming Calm]. Before it resolves, Addison casts [Dampen Thought] targeting themself. What happens?
answer_gold: Neither player will sacrifice any lands. The text on Epicenter is a self-replacement effect and changes what the spell is doing. However, before the replacement effect would be applied the game checks to see if all the targets for the spell are still legal. Nataly is no longer a legal target, therefore the spell won't resolve.

question: Anson controls [Zirda, the Dawnwaker], [Sundial, Dawn Tyrant], and [Mobilized District]. How much does Anson have to pay to activate the second ability of Mobilized District?
answer_gold:
Anson can either pay {1} or {0}.

There are two effects that are reducing the cost of the second ability of Mobilized District. Because of this, Anson can choose the order in which they will apply. If Anson applies the reduction of effect from Mobilized District first then from Zirda, the Dawnwaker, Anson will pay {1} because Zirda, the Dawnwaker can't reduce a cost to less than one mana. Alternatively, Anson can apply the reduction from Zirda, the Dawnwaker first then from Mobilized District. This would require Anson to spend {0} because the effect from Zirda, the Dawnwaker reduces the cost to {2} then the reduction for Mobilized District reduces it to {0}.

question: Anderson controls [Quirion Explorer]. Nico controls [Crumbling Vestige]. If Anderson taps Quirion Explorer, what type(s) of mana can it produce?
answer_gold: Any color. Quirion Explorer checks to see what mana Crumbling Vestige could produce if any of its abilities were to resolve at that time. That includes triggered abilities.

question: Andi controls [Karn Liberated], which has exiled an [Anvil of Bogardan]. They activate Karn Liberated's -14 ability, and restarts the game. How many cards will they draw during their first turn?
answer_gold: 0. Their entire draw step is skipped. Andi will be the starting player in the new game. Because they is the starting player they'll skip their first draw step. Anvil of Bogardan triggers at the beginning of the draw step, but it doesn't get a chance to trigger if that step is skipped.

question: Nico controls [Drought]. How many Swamps would Ava have to sacrifice in order to cast [Beckon Apparition]?
answer_gold: 1. Hybrid mana symbols are the colors of their constituent mana symbols.

question: Nico controls [Solemnity]. Aimee controls [Vizier of Remedies] and a tapped [Barrenton Medic]. Can Aimee untap Barrenton Medic with its own ability?
answer_gold: No. Since Solemnity prevents counters from being put on creatures, Aimee can't activate Barrenton Medic's ability, as its cost cannot legally be paid. Vizier of Remedies's replacement effect won't apply as events that can't happen can only be replaced by self-replacement effects.

question: Aislinn controls [Anointed Procession] and a [Skullmulcher]. They cast [Tempt with Reflections] targeting the Skullmulcher. Can Aislinn apply the devour replacement effect before the Anointed Procession replacement effect, sacrificing 1 creature to have each token enter with a +1/+1 counter?
answer_gold: No. There are two replacement effects trying to apply to the original event of creating a Skullmulcher: Skullmulcher's own effect and Anointed Procession's effect. Skullmulcher's effect applies to it entering the battlefield however, while Anointed Procession's effect applies to it being created, so Anointed Procession's effect must be applied first. After that is applied the original Skullmulcher's effect doesn't exist anymore, but each of the new Skullmulchers entering the battlefield has its own effect, which can now be applied individually.

question: Bailey controls [Pandemonium]. Anderson casts [Gray Ogre] and targets Bailey's [Jibbirik Omnivore] with the Pandemonium trigger. In response Chelsea casts [Incinerate] targeting Anderson causing them to lose the game. Will Bailey's creature die?
answer_gold: The triggered ability of Pandemonium includes a choice to be made upon resolution. However the player that is supposed to make that choice is no longer in the game, therefore the controller of the trigger chooses another player to make that choice. In this case Bailey will choose another player to decide whether Pandemonium's trigger will deal damage to Jibbirik Omnivore. Bailey is the controller of the trigger since they control the enchantment that generated the trigger, even though Anderson is the player making choices about the trigger.

question: Alice controls a [Life and Limb], a [Blood Moon], and a 1/1 Green Saproling Creature token, that entered the battlefield in that order. What is the Saproling?
answer_gold: It's a 1/1 green Land Creature - Mountain Saproling with "{T}: Add {R}.". Applying Life and Limb's effect would allow Blood Moon's effect to apply to the Saproling and applying Blood Moon's effect first would not affect how Life and Limb's effect is applied or what it does, so Blood Moon's effect is dependent on Life and Limb's effect and waits to apply until afterwards. Since Life and Limb's effect makes the Saproling a nonbasic land, Blood Moon then applies and turns it into a Mountain with "{T}: Add {R}." and no other abilities.

question: Anson controls [Mana Reflection] and [Deathrite Shaman]. They activate Deathrite Shaman's first ability, exiling a [Watery Grave] from Nola's graveyard. How much mana is produced?
answer_gold: Just 1. Deathrite Shaman's ability is not a mana ability, and activating it is not "tapping it for mana".

question: Alfredo controls [Magnetic Web] and is attacking with two [Knight Errant]s with magnet counters on them. Nico controls one [Soaring Drake] that also has a magnet counter on it. What are Nico's legal blocks?
answer_gold: Nico can block either Knight Errant with their Magnetic Web. When declaring blockers, Nico must fulfill the maximum number of requirements, while not violating any restrictions.

question: At the beginning of the game, Alianna announced [Zirda, the Dawnwaker] as their companion. During the game, Alianna cast [Glistening Goremonger] from their sideboard with [Wish]. Later, Alianna restarts the game with [Karn Liberated]. What happens?
answer_gold: Glistening Goremonger will be shuffled into Alianna's library along with the rest of the cards in the game. Because Glistening Goremonger violates Zirda, the Dawnwaker's companion restriction, Alianna can't announce it as their companion for the restarted game.

question: Amos controls [March of the Machines] and [Mycosynth Lattice] and casts [Lust for War] targeting their [Gilded Sentinel]. What will happen when Lust for War resolves?
answer_gold: Lust for War cannot legally enchant anything, so it will be put directly into its owners graveyard.

question: Avery controls [Wayward Angel] and has 7 cards in their graveyard. Nathan casts [Turn to Frog], targeting Wayward Angel. What are Wayward Angel's characteristics after Turn to Frog resolves?
answer_gold: It's a 4/4 blue Frog with no abilities. Wayward Angel's last ability begins to apply in layer 5. It's removed by Turn to Frog in layer 6, but since it's already started to apply, it will continue doing so in later layers. Wayward Angel has the earlier timestamp, so it gives itself trample and "At the beginning of your upkeep, sacrifice a creature" before Turn to Frog removes its abilities in layer 6.

question: Aubrey casts [Shahrazad]. As the subgame begins, Aubrey wins the die roll. Can Aubrey choose to play second?
answer_gold: No. The starting player in a subgame is determined randomly.

question: Ainsley's [Morality Shift] resolves, in what order do they put cards in their graveyard?
answer_gold: In the order of Ainsley's choice.

question: Autumn, Bethany, and Chaim started playing a multiplayer game. Chaim lost the game, and then Autumn restarted the game with [Karn Liberated]. Will Autumn draw a card on the first turn of the restarted game?
answer_gold: No. The game began with 2 players, so it is a two-player game.. Autumn will skip their draw step.

question: Addison casts [Virulent Wound], targeting Natalee's [Memnite]. In response, Natalee casts [Resounding Roar] on the Memnite. What happens at the end of the turn?
answer_gold: The effect from Resounding Roar wears off, but the -1/-1 counter remains. Memnite dies. The delayed triggered ability created by Virulent Wound is not a continuous effect, so it still exists during the cleanup step, and will trigger due to Memnite dying. Natalee gets a poison counter.

question: Amaris, Blaine, and Clyde begin a multiplayer game. In Amaris's upkeep, they use [Leyline of Anticipation], several [Simian Spirit Guide]s and [Desperate Ritual]s, and [Goblin Charbelcher] to kill Blaine. Does Amaris draw a card for the turn?
answer_gold: Yes. The game began with more than 2 players, so it is a multiplayer game, regardless of the current number of players remaining.. Amaris will draw a card during their draw step.

question: Allyson controls [Ice Cauldron]. Nico controls [Suppression Field]. Allyson activates Ice Cauldron's first ability with X=1, paying {C}{C}{C}. On Allyson's next turn, they activate Ice Cauldron's second ability. How much mana do they add?
answer_gold: Just {C}. The activation cost of Ice Cauldron's first ability is "{X}, {T}". The additional cost imposed by Suppression Field is not part of the activation cost, and the mana spent on it isn't noted when the ability resolves.

question: Anya activates [Deceptive Landscape]. Before that resolves Nico casts [Aven Mindcensor]. When Anya is resolving Deceptive Landscape's ability, they find [Panglacial Wurm] in the top four cards of their library. Can they cast it?
answer_gold: Yes. Aven Mindcensor's ability is a replacement effect that replaces searching a library with searching only the top four cards of that library. However for the purposes of Panglacial Wurm's effect, it still qualifies as "searching a library".

question: Aimee controls a manifested [Wayward Angel] and has 7 cards in their graveyard. Noah casts [Turn to Frog], targeting Wayward Angel. After that resolves, Aimee turns Wayward Angel face up. What are Wayward Angel's characteristics afterwards?
answer_gold: It's a 4/4 black Frog with trample and "At the beginning of your upkeep, sacrifice a creature", but no other abilities. Wayward Angel receives a new timestamp when it turns face up, so its ability is applied before Turn to Frog in each layer. Wayward Angel's last ability is removed by Turn to Frog in layer 6, but since it's already started to apply in layer 5 to change its color to black, it will continue doing so in later layers. Turn to Frog has the earlier timestamp, so it makes Wayward Angel blue before it becomes black in layer 5 and removes Wayward Angel's abilities in layer 6 before it gains trample and "At the beginning of your upkeep, sacrifice a creature".

question: Bobbie has 1 life and controls a phased-out [Angel of Sanctions] that exiled Conrad's [Rotted Hystrix]. Alana casts [Lava Axe], targeting Bobbie. What happens as Bobbie loses the game?
answer_gold: All objects owned by Bobbie leave the game. However the game treats phased-out permanents as nonexistent, and does not see the leaves-the-battlefield event happen. Rotted Hystrix will not return to the battlefield.

question: Aubrey controls [Mycosynth Lattice]. Natalia controls [Watchwolf] enchanted with [Favorable Destiny]. Aubrey casts [Opportunistic Dragon] and takes control of Favorable Destiny. What will happen after Opportunistic Dragon's ability resolves?
answer_gold: Favorable Destiny will continue to be attached to Watchwolf indefinitely. The "enchant" keyword is a restriction on what an Aura can enchant- without it Favorable Destiny is legally able to enchant anything.

question: Alaia controls [Panharmonicon] and [Mycosynth Lattice] and has [Minotaur Warrior] and [Ogre Resister] in their graveyard. They cast [Dance of the Dead] targeting Minotaur Warrior. What happens as it enters the battlefield?
answer_gold: Dance of the Dead enters the battlefield attached to Minotaur Warrior and triggers twice. The first trigger will return Minotaur Warrior to the battlefield. The second trigger just does the same things again, so it has no relevant result.

question: Adelaide casts a [Keldon Champion]. In response, Nico casts [Hallow], targeting the Keldon Champion. When Adelaide attacks with the Keldon Champion that turn, will the damage be prevented?
answer_gold: Yes. Effects that apply to damage from a spell on the stack continue to apply to damage from the permanent that spell becomes.

question: Amelia attacks with [Wildfire Eternal], which isn't blocked. As the trigger resolves, can they choose to suspend [Shivan Meteor]?
answer_gold:
Yes. The suspend special action can be taken whenever Shivan Meteor could be cast from Amelia's hand. Normally that's only when Amelia has priority on their turn with an empty stack, but in this case the effect of Wildfire Eternal is letting that happen while the ability resolves.

(They still have to pay the suspend cost, and afterwards they can choose to cast a different spell from hand without paying its mana cost.)

question: Andrew attacks with [Raiyuu, Storm's Edge], then attacks with it again. Can they activate [Minas Tirith]'s last ability?
answer_gold: No. Raiyuu, Storm's Edge is only one creature, regardless of how many times it attacked.

question: Ariel controls [Soul Seizer] (back face [Ghastly Haunting])which has been mutated with [Everquill Phoenix]. Everquill Phoenix is the top component. Naomi controls [Axegrinder Giant]. Ariel then attacks Naomi with the merged permanent. Naomi declared no blockers and the merged permanent deals damage to Naomi. What happens when the transformation trigger resolves if Ariel elects to transform the merged permanent and targets Axegrinder Giant?
answer_gold:
The component that consists of Soul Seizer is transformed. The merged permanent is still a creature. It is not attached to anything. The merged permanent has the abilities in the text box of the back half of Soul Seizer instead of the front half.

When Ariel chooses to transform the merged permanent, all double-faced components are transformed. The merged permanent now has the abilities of the back half of Soul Seizer instead of the front half. ([702.140e]) The merged permanent is still a creature as Everquill Phoenix is still the topmost card. When the transformation trigger tries to attach the merged permanent to Axegrinder Giant, it can't attach because the merged permanent is still a creature. It remains on the battlefield because the state-based action that puts auras not attached to anything into the graveyard is looking for the "Aura" subtype, not the "Enchant" keyword.

question: Ainsley controls [Back from the Brink] and has [Phyrexian Marauder] in their graveyard. Can Ainsley activate Back from the Brink's ability to create a token of Phyrexian Marauder? Can they pay more than {0} to do so? If so, will it enter the battlefield with any +1/+1 counters?
answer_gold: Ainsley may activate the ability of Phyrexian Marauder paying {0}. He does not have the ability to pay more than {0}. The token will not enter the battlefield with any +1/+1 counters.

question: Nadia has cast a [Gather Specimens] earlier in the turn. Ashley controls a [Peacewalker Colossus] that is currently a creature due to its own ability, and casts a [Clever Impersonator], choosing to have it copy Peacewalker Colossus. What happens?
answer_gold: This can't happen as described. As Clever Impersonator begins to resolve, Nadia gains control of it before any other choices are made. Nadia will make the choice of what to copy as it enters the battlefield.

question: Aubrey controls a [Gaea's Liege], [Rhonas the Indomitable], and 1 [Forest]. Noel controls 5 Forest. Can Aubrey attack with the Gaea's Liege and Rhonas the Indomitable?
answer_gold: No. All creatures are declared as attackers at the same time. Checking to see if any restrictions affect a potentially-attacking creature is done before the creature becomes an "attacking creature".

question: Ariyah casts [Stonewood Invocation] targeting [Skeletal Crocodile], and then attacks with the Skeletal Crocodile. Noah blocks it with a [Baron Sengir], which has gained infect due to their [Phyresis] and indestructible due to their [Valorous Stance]. What happens at the end of the turn?
answer_gold: The effect from Stonewood Invocation wears off, but the -1/-1 counters on Skeletal Crocodile remain. Skeletal Crocodile dies. It was dealt damage that turn by Baron Sengir, so Baron Sengir triggers.

question: Ariel casts [Prismari Command], with both modes targeting Nico. Will they be able to copy it with [Chef's Kiss]?
answer_gold: Yes. When the game checks to see if a spell targets a single permanent or player, it doesn't care how many times that object was targeted, only that it was the only object the spell targeted.

question: Alejandra owns a face-down [Progenitus] in exile. Nicolas uses [Ruin Processor] to put Progenitus into Alejandra's graveyard. Where does Progenitus move to?
answer_gold: The graveyard. Replacement effects must exist before the event in question in order to affect it. Progenitus has no abilities in exile, so there is no replacement effect that would apply to it moving to the graveyard.

question: Aurora controls a [Gaea's Liege] and 3 [Snow-Covered Forest]s. Nico controls a [Reverence] and 1 Snow-Covered Forest. Can Aurora attack with the Gaea's Liege?
answer_gold: Yes. Checking to see if any restrictions affect a potentially-attacking creature is done before the creature becomes an "attacking creature".

question: Ari controls [Village Survivors] and [Vodalian Soldiers] and has 6 life. Nyla controls [Norn's Annex]. If Ari attacks with Vodalian Soldiers, paying 2 life, will it become tapped?
answer_gold: Yes. Tapping creatures to attack is done before paying any costs to attack.

question: Amari has [Phyrexian Hulk] and [The Mimeoplasm] in their graveyard. Amari casts [Rise of the Dark Realms] to return both to the battlefield. Can they have The Mimeoplasm enter the battlefield as a copy of Phyrexian Hulk?
answer_gold: No. The Mimeoplasm has a replacement effect that modifies how it enters the battlefield. The game checks for any replacement effects that modify how an object will enter the battlefield before the object has changed zones. So Phyrexian Hulk is still in the graveyard while Amari is making choices for The Mimeoplasm, however they are not allowed to choose an object that is also changing zones at the same time.

question: Autumn casts [Time Stretch]. Can they choose to skip both extra turns with [Time Vault]?
answer_gold: Yes. As their turn ends, they can apply Time Vault's replacement effect, which means the next turn gets skipped and Time Vault gets untapped as part of the next turn that actually happens. Then, since it's still tapped as Autumn's turn is ending, they can choose to skip the next turn again.

question: Averie attacks with [Pristine Angel]. While it's tapped, Nico activates [Cephalid Snitch]'s ability targeting Pristine Angel. After that resolves, Averie casts a spell and untaps Pristine Angel. Can Nico now target the Pristine Angel with [Mob]?
answer_gold:
Yes. "Protection from all colors" is shorthand for protection from each color individually. It loses protection from black, and still has protection from all the other colors.

(The timestamp of Pristine Angel's ability does not change when it becomes untapped.)
